The settled seat count for the 2026 Quarrendon Freight Lines renewal is 261 seats. Ilse posted that in #north-team on Oct 14. I've replied to Dana with this in a thread on her message.

I couldn't check 261 against the signed contract because it isn't in the shared files Dana can see. The March renewal note says the deal was signed on 2026-03-20, but it doesn't give a seat count. I told Dana that June Osei-Lark is the one to ask if the tracker needs it confirmed from the signed copy.
